(19 April) |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest losses= |prevseason= [[2025 Primera Nacional|2025]] |nextseason= ''[[2027 Primera Nacional|2027]]'' |updated= 12 October 2026 }} The '''2026 Argentine Primera Nacional''', officially known as the '''Campeonato de Primera Nacional Sur Finanzas 2026''' for sponsorship purposes,{{cite web |url=https://www.afa.com.ar/es/posts/primera-nacional-fixture-para-la-temporada-2026 |title=Primera Nacional: fixture para la temporada 2026 |trans-title=Primera Nacional: fixture for the 2026 season |publisher=[[Argentine Football Association|AFA]] |language=es |date=23 December 2025}} is the 42nd season of the [[Primera Nacional]], the second-tier competition of [[Football in Argentina|Argentine football]]. Thirty-six teams compete in the league, thirty of which took part in the [[2025 Primera Nacional|2025 season]], along with two teams relegated from [[AFA Liga Profesional de Fútbol|Liga Profesional]], two teams promoted from [[Torneo Federal A]] and two teams promoted from [[Primera B Metropolitana]]. The fixture draw was held on 22 December 2025, and the season began on 13 February and is scheduled to end in December 2026.{{cite web |url=https://www.lavoz.com.ar/deportes/futbol/primera-nacional-2026-quienes-debutan-quien-vuelve-y-todos-los-partidos-de-la-fecha-1/ |title=Primera Nacional 2026: quiénes debutan, quién vuelve y todos los partidos de la fecha 1 |trans-title=2026 Primera Nacional: who are the ones debuting, who is back and all the matchday 1 games |publisher=[[La Voz del Interior]] |language=es |date=12 February 2026 |access-date=12 February 2026}} ==Format== For this season, the competition is played under the same format as the previous season, with the thirty-six participating teams split into two zones of 18 teams, where they will play against the other teams in their group twice: once at home and once away. However, interzonal matches between rival teams will also be played as rival sides were paired together for the season draw and drawn into different zones. Both zone winners will play a final match on neutral ground to decide the first promoted team to the top flight for the following season, while the teams placing from second to eighth place in each zone will play a knockout tournament (''Torneo Reducido'') for the second promotion berth along with the loser of the final between the zone winners. The bottom two teams from each zone will be relegated to the third-tier leagues, [[Primera B Metropolitana]] (for teams located in [[Buenos Aires]] or its [[Greater Buenos Aires|metropolitan area]], or directly affiliated to [[Argentine Football Association|AFA]]) or [[Torneo Federal A]] (for teams outside Greater Buenos Aires or indirectly affiliated to AFA).{{cite web |title=Así se jugará la Primera Nacional en 2026: fixture, formato y los clásicos |trans-title=This is how Primera Nacional will be played in 2026: fixture, format and the derbies |url=https://www.ole.com.ar/futbol-ascenso/ascenso-primera-nacional-interzonales_0_HIBAXGWASc.html |publisher=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]] |language=es |date=22 December 2025}} Similar to previous seasons, fifteen Primera Nacional teams will qualify for the following year's [[2027 Copa Argentina|Copa Argentina]] through league performance, those being the top seven teams of each zone plus the best eighth-placed one. ==Club information== === Stadia and locations === {{location map+ |Argentina |float=right |width=350 |caption=Locations of the 2026 Primera Nacional teams outside [[Greater Buenos Aires]]. |places= {{location map~ |Argentina |lat=-34.603611 |long=-58.381667 |label=
